legal_standard: FACT = Canada.ca DIA speech/backgrounder. Preferred supplier ≠ signed procurement contract.

facts.claim: On 6 July 2026, Government of Canada selected Thyssenkrupp Marine Systems (TKMS) as preferred supplier for Canada’s next generation of submarines (up to 12).
Hanwha Ocean designated Reserve Supplier if preferred-supplier negotiations fail.
Backgrounder: Canada will conclude contracting no later than end of 2027; first four submarines to be delivered in 2034 (ahead of Victoria-class mid-to-late 2030s retirement).

Process timeline (backgrounder): RFI Sep 2024–Feb 2025; two qualified suppliers 26 Aug 2025; proposal instructions Nov 2025; proposals Mar 2026; bid clarification to 29 Apr 2026; preferred supplier 6 Jul 2026.
Fuhr speech: 'Less than eight months ago, Canada identified the qualified suppliers. Today, we’ve selected a preferred supplier' — explicit acceleration framing.

investigative_read: INFERENCE: compression is now government-owned language, not outsider critique. Preferred supplier is not a signed hull contract — negotiations through 2027 remain the accountability surface (cost envelope, ITB, industrial workshare).
